standard.summary: phase 为默认训练生命周期策略
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.aggressive: 卸得更勤，冲低显存，等待会多。
optionDescriptions.resident: TE/VAE 一直占着 GPU，最快也最占。
optionDescriptions.grouped: CLIP-L 与 VAE 常驻 GPU，9.2GB 的 T5 仍每步搬；少搬运但显存段更多，实测不一定更快。

standard_en.summary: phase is the default training-lifecycle policy
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.phase: Offloads the TE/VAE by training phase.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Offloads more often, pushing VRAM down at the cost of more waiting.
optionDescriptions.resident: The TE/VAE hold the GPU the whole time: the fastest and the most expensive.
optionDescriptions.grouped: CLIP-L and the VAE stay resident on the GPU while the 9.2GB T5 is still moved every step; less transfer but more memory segments, and measurement shows it is not necessarily faster.

advanced.principle: phase 为默认训练生命周期策略；aggressive 面向 6GB 低显存目标；resident 保持兼容但显存占用更高；grouped 只让 CLIP-L 与 VAE 常驻，T5 仍每步搬运

advanced_en.principle: phase is the default training-lifecycle strategy; aggressive targets 6GB low-VRAM setups; resident stays compatible but uses more VRAM; grouped keeps only CLIP-L and VAE resident, with T5 still moved every step.
